versions.changelog:
- Initial release of llm-behavior-distill skill.
- Distills core behaviors from 15 leading open-source LLMs (e.g., DeepSeek, Qwen, ChatGLM, Yi, MiniMax, Kimi, Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi, DBRX, etc.) into reusable Python modules.
- Provides modular functions for advanced agent capabilities: chain-of-thought reasoning, tool orchestration/structuring, long-context handling, subagent execution, self-evolving templates, compression, safety alignment, MoE expert routing, compliance, and multilingual understanding.
- Supports both automatic expert routing and manual composition of behavioral modules for flexible agent assembly.
- Emphasizes safety, efficiency, and composability, enabling scalable and robust intelligent agent design.
